newsitem.title: USA: HFS execs depart from AMRE board.
newsitem.headline: HFS execs depart from AMRE board.

text.p: HFS Inc and AMRE Inc said on Monday that John Snodgrass and Stephen Holmes, vice chairmen of HFS, have resigned from AMRE's board of directors, effective immediately, over a potential conflict of interests.
The resignations are due to a potential conflict related to the restructuring of the Century 21 Home Improvements license agreement in connection with AMRE's talks about its financing strategies.
During the fourth quarter of 1996, HFS fully reserved for its investment in and receivable from AMRE, the companies said.

AMRE said in late November that it would defer $9.6 million of its 1996 royalty obligation to HFS and modify other royalty payments. AMRE said at the time it is seeking options for raising more capital.
